sudoku.a1: Fill the 9 × 9 grid so that every row, every column and every 3 × 3 box holds each digit from 1 to 9 exactly once. The black digits are given and cannot change; yours are pink.
sudoku.q2: How do I enter numbers and notes?
sudoku.a2: Tap a cell, then a number on the pad, or type 1–9 on a keyboard. Turn on Notes (or press N) to pencil in small candidates instead. Erase or Backspace clears a cell.
sudoku.q3: What is the difference between the levels?
sudoku.a3: Easy puzzles can be finished by spotting cells with only one possible digit. Medium also needs a digit with only one place left in a row, column or box. Hard and expert need more advanced steps and have fewer given digits.
sudoku.q4: Does every puzzle have one solution?
sudoku.a4: Yes. Each puzzle is checked when it is made and has exactly one solution, so you never have to guess.
sudoku.a5: Yes, in this browser only. Close the page and come back later to carry on with the same puzzle, notes and time. Nothing is sent to cv.cm.

tic-tac-toe.a1: Two players take turns placing X and O on a 3 × 3 grid. The first to get three in a row, across, down or diagonally, wins. If the grid fills with no line, it is a draw.
tic-tac-toe.a2: On easy and medium, yes. On hard the computer plays perfectly, so the best you can do is a draw.
tic-tac-toe.a3: X always moves first. Choose Play as O to let the computer start.
tic-tac-toe.q4: Can two people play on one device?
tic-tac-toe.a4: Yes. Choose Two players and take turns tapping the grid.
tic-tac-toe.q5: What is the best first move?
tic-tac-toe.a5: A corner. It gives the other player the most ways to go wrong; the centre is the safest reply.

color-blindness-test.q1: How does the color blindness test work?
color-blindness-test.a1: Each plate is a circle of coloured dots with a number made of dots in a different colour. The two colours differ only in what one type of cone in the eye sees, so someone who lacks that cone cannot find the number.
color-blindness-test.q2: What do protan, deutan and tritan mean?
color-blindness-test.a2: Protan means the red-sensitive cones are missing or weak, deutan the green-sensitive ones (the most common kind), and tritan the blue-sensitive ones. Protan and deutan together are red–green color blindness.
color-blindness-test.a3: No. Screens show colours differently and this test is not calibrated, so it can only point to a possible deficiency. An optometrist or ophthalmologist can test you properly.
color-blindness-test.q4: How accurate is an online color blindness test?
color-blindness-test.a4: It works best on a good screen at full brightness, with night mode, blue-light filters and colour filters turned off. Take it again on another screen if the result surprises you.
color-blindness-test.a5: No. The plates are drawn for cv.cm on the same principle, with new random numbers and dot layouts every time you retake the test.

military-time.q1: How do I convert military time to standard time?
military-time.a1: From 1300 on, subtract 12 from the hours and add PM: 1430 is 2:30 PM. From 0100 to 1159 it is the same time with AM. 1200 is 12:00 PM (noon) and 0000 is 12:00 AM (midnight).
military-time.q2: How do I say military time?
military-time.a2: Read the four digits as two pairs: 1430 is "fourteen thirty hours". Whole hours use "hundred": 0800 is "zero eight hundred hours". A leading zero is said as "zero".
military-time.a3: 0000 is the start of a day. Some people write 2400 for the end of the day, which is the same moment as 0000 the next day.
military-time.a4: Zulu time is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), written with a Z, such as 1430Z. The page shows the current Zulu time next to your local time.
military-time.a5: Four digits (1430), 24-hour time with a colon (14:30), or 12-hour time with AM or PM (2:30 pm). It works both ways.

height-calculator.q1: How can I predict my child's adult height?
height-calculator.a1: Add both parents' heights, add 13 cm (5 in) for a boy or subtract 13 cm for a girl, and halve it. Most children end up within 8.5 cm (about 3.5 in) of that figure.
height-calculator.q2: What does the growth chart method add?
height-calculator.a2: Give your child's age and height, and the calculator finds their percentile on the CDC growth charts and the adult height on the same percentile at age 20.
height-calculator.q3: How accurate is a height prediction?
height-calculator.a3: It is an estimate. Genes set a range; nutrition, sleep, health and the timing of puberty decide where in it a child ends up. A child who matures early can look tall for their age and finish average.
height-calculator.q4: Which ages does it work for?
height-calculator.a4: The growth chart part works from 2 to 20 years. The parents' method works at any age.
height-calculator.q5: When should I talk to a doctor?
height-calculator.a5: If your child's height drops across percentile lines, or is far below the parents' target range, ask a paediatrician.

sudoku.lead: Solve a sudoku in three steps.
sudoku.s1b: The page opens on a medium puzzle. Choose another level to start a new one, or tap New puzzle.
sudoku.s2b: Tap a cell and a number. Each row, column and 3 × 3 box needs 1 to 9 once. Turn on Notes to pencil in options.
sudoku.s3b: Clashing digits are underlined. Turn on Show mistakes to check against the answer, or use Hint when stuck.

tic-tac-toe.lead: Play a game of tic-tac-toe in three steps.
tic-tac-toe.s1b: Against the computer (easy, medium or hard) or Two players on one screen.
tic-tac-toe.s2b: Tap an empty square to place your mark. X moves first.
tic-tac-toe.s3b: A line across, down or diagonal wins. Tap New game for the next round; the score adds up.

color-blindness-test.lead: Check your colour vision in three steps.
color-blindness-test.s1b: Turn the brightness up and night mode or blue-light filters off.
color-blindness-test.s2b: Type the number you see, or tap I see no number. There are 13 plates.
color-blindness-test.s3b: You get a score for red (protan), green (deutan) and blue (tritan) plates and a list of every answer.

military-time.lead: Convert military time in three steps.
military-time.s1b: Use four digits such as 1430, or 12-hour time such as 2:30 pm.
military-time.s2b: See the military time, the 24-hour time, the 12-hour time and how to say it.
military-time.s3b: The chart lists every hour, and the current local and Zulu (UTC) times are shown too.

height-calculator.lead: Estimate your child's adult height in three steps.
height-calculator.s1b: Choose centimetres or feet and inches, the child's sex, and both parents' heights.
height-calculator.s2b: Optional: give their age (2–20) and height for the growth chart method.
height-calculator.s3b: See the parents' target and range, your child's percentile and the height on the same percentile at 20.

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.privacyNote: Fill every row, column and 3 × 3 box with 1 to 9. Your game is saved in this browser.
sudoku.keys: Keyboard: arrows move, 1–9 enter, 0 or Backspace erases, N switches notes, Ctrl+Z undoes. Copy puzzle gives the 81-digit line other sudoku apps read.
sudoku.clash: The underlined digits repeat in a row, column or box.
sudoku.levelPending: Your game is kept. Tap New puzzle to start a {level} puzzle.

ticTacToe.title: Tic-tac-toe
ticTacToe.privacyNote: Get three in a row before the other side does.
ticTacToe.hint: Tip: start in a corner. On hard the computer never loses, so a draw is a good result.

colorBlindnessTest.title: Color blindness test
colorBlindnessTest.privacyNote: Type the number you see in each plate. Answers stay in this page.
colorBlindnessTest.err_answer: Type the one- or two-digit number, or tap I see no number.
colorBlindnessTest.r_demo: The first plate, which everyone should read, was missed. Check your screen settings and try again before reading anything into the result.
colorBlindnessTest.r_normal: No sign of a colour vision deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.r_all: Several kinds of plates were missed. That can point to a colour vision deficiency, but it is often the screen: try again on another screen with filters turned off.
colorBlindnessTest.r_protan_mild: Signs of a mild red (protan) colour weakness.
colorBlindnessTest.r_protan_strong: Signs of a strong red (protan) colour deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.r_deutan_mild: Signs of a mild green (deutan) colour weakness.
colorBlindnessTest.r_deutan_strong: Signs of a strong green (deutan) colour deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.r_tritan_mild: Signs of a mild blue–yellow (tritan) colour weakness.
colorBlindnessTest.r_tritan_strong: Signs of a strong blue–yellow (tritan) colour deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.disclaimer: This is a screening on an uncalibrated screen, not a diagnosis. Missing only the very faint plates is common. See an optometrist for a proper test.
colorBlindnessTest.tip1: Use full brightness and turn off night mode, blue-light and colour filters.
colorBlindnessTest.tip2: Look at each plate for no more than a few seconds.
colorBlindnessTest.tip3: If you wear glasses for reading or distance, wear them.

militaryTime.title: Military time converter
militaryTime.privacyNote: Type a time in military, 24-hour or 12-hour form to convert it.
militaryTime.err_invalid: That is not a time. Try 1430, 14:30 or 2:30 pm.

heightCalculator.title: Height calculator
heightCalculator.privacyNote: Estimate how tall a child will be from the parents' heights and, optionally, the child's height and age.
heightCalculator.childHint: Ages 2 to 20. Leave the height empty to use the parents' method alone.
heightCalculator.err_age: Age must be between 2 and 20 years, with months from 0 to 11.
heightCalculator.mainBoth: Predicted adult height: {parents} from the parents, {chart} from the growth chart
heightCalculator.stepRange: Range: the target ± {range} cm, where most children end up.
heightCalculator.stepPercentile: CDC growth chart: percentile {pct} now (z = {z}); the same z at 20 years is {result} cm.
heightCalculator.outside: The growth chart estimate is outside the parents' range. That is common in early or late puberty; a doctor can tell more.
heightCalculator.disclaimer: An estimate, not medical advice. Growth charts: CDC 2000 (United States).
